scope: Descriptive interpretation of the already fixed model and evaluation objects; no fitting, selection, reapproval or new economic rule.
authoritative_outputs: All four Q2 objects and five Q1 objects, all60 original evaluation IDs121–180, all nine predeclared summary rows and every path record. No exclusions or preferred comparator selection.
primary_service: Complete guarded C service remains preinvestment executionReview because selected-beta inner10 exceeds same-U B8. Primary finance is NULL, with originalN60, auto0 and review60; no shadow or benchmark returns are substituted.

Q2_shadow_comparisons.shadow: Only original rejected fixed45/5/50, eta.03, H30/L.4, unchanged1–120 forecastfan and kernels.
Q2_shadow_comparisons.population: Exact paired original IDs121–180, one observation per original ID in each comparison. Both reference comparisons must be displayed, with all60 pairs retained.
Q2_shadow_comparisons.difference_direction: Unapproved shadow minus each named reference.
Q2_shadow_comparisons.aggregate_differences: For each of the five metrics, report arithmetic mean and ordinary median of the60 paired differences, as well as positive/negative/equality counts at the original1e-12 numerical convention. Annual log_growth differences are distinct from CAGR differences and total log wealth.
Q2_shadow_comparisons.events: Preserve complete original-ID lists for neither breach, shadow-only breach, reference-only breach and both breach. Report event count differences descriptively; no significance or population guarantee is inferred.
Q2_shadow_comparisons.all_results: Growth, risk, fees and trading changes are presented together, including all adverse results. Shadow finance is always labelled unapproved research.

Q1: Use fixed A–E suitability labels and own H/L/liquidity. Available B/C/E product metrics are static annual target-restoration references, including after crossing; A/D finance stays NULL. C Q1 Balanced does not authorize Q2 execution. Do not rank unlike own-H populations as interchangeable service trials.

metric_conventions.growth: Net real annual log_growth=(ln(real_terminal)-ln100)/originalH; CAGR=exp(log_growth)-1. Mean annualG, mean CAGR and median CAGR are separate.
metric_conventions.risk: Original-history annual-endpoint real MDD; strict event iff MDD-L>1e-12. Ordinary volatility uses net real annual-return sample sd(ddof1).
metric_conventions.quantiles: Medians average the two middle observations; P10 CAGR and P90 MDD use empirical generalized inverse/inverted_cdf. CVaR90 uses the worst10percent probability mass, including fractional boundary atoms (six complete observations at n60).
metric_conventions.trades: Actual moved amount>1e-12 over originalH periods including inception and pending; restore labels alone do not define a physical trade.
metric_conventions.units: Growth/CAGR/MDD/trade differences displayed as percentage points; fees in initial-100 nominal units. No invented currency units.

reading_figure_if_created: Plot all60 paired shadow-minus-same-target-B annualG differences against MDD differences, percentage points on both axes, with zero reference lines and no omitted outliers. Label as unapproved shadow research; the primary service has no financial points. Display all three Q2 research/reference summary rows and the primary NULL row alongside the figure.
case_and_sensitivity: Keep the already chosen development severe example outer_r5_112 and the already bridged development five-known-cost study. Do not choose a new flattering final case, add final fee searches or reselect a model.
